A few entries also have their simulation written in R. Each R version runs in your browser with [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/), a version of R compiled to WebAssembly, so there is nothing to install. You can edit the code and run it again.

The R pages are separate from the entries because webR is a large download. The first R page you open downloads R itself, which can take a minute. The entry pages stay fast.

This is a pilot with four entries. If it proves useful, more will follow.
